Why study abroad now

Europe & the world are wide open

🎓

Tuition-free options

Public universities in Germany and Norway charge little to no tuition — even for international students.

💼

Stay & work after study

Germany offers an 18-month job-seeker visa, the UK a 2-year Graduate Route, Australia up to 4 years post-study work.

⏱️

Earn while you learn

Most countries let international students work up to 20 hours a week during term — covering living costs.

🇪🇺

Funded pathways

Erasmus+, DSU, DAAD and MEXT put fully-funded degrees within reach — we match you to the right one.
